summary.text: Joseph Steinberger, a certified write-in candidate on the Faith in Humanity Party line, listed by Spectrum News as living in Rockland, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. Senate in Maine to Troy Jackson, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
No campaign website, statements or Ballotpedia survey were found.

sources.title: Maine's U.S. Senate race to include 6 write-in candidates, triggering ranked-choice voting
